title: Ask for the saint who can show the way
summary: Peace begins with the humility to ask for the saint who can show the way past ego's curtain.
takeaway: Ask for guidance before confusion becomes pride.
lifeApplication: When the mind starts multiplying methods, bring the question to a trusted sangat voice and let being shown matter more than appearing certain.

source.shortMeaning: The heart asks for a saint who can show the way because ego still curtains the One within.
source.lifeApplication: Name the real question plainly, then seek the company wise enough to guide it without flattering your pride.

evidence.coreClaim: The heart asks for a saint who can show the way because ego still curtains the One within.
evidence.turn: Let the honest plea for guidance interrupt the ego that pretends it already sees.
evidence.practicalImplication: When confusion multiplies methods, bring the question to a trusted sangat voice and let being shown matter more than appearing certain.
